opportunities.description:
Native American Connections Parade 2026

Saturday, October 10, 2026 | 7:00 AM - 2:00 PM | 6 Meaningful Opportunities

Native American Connections (NAC) is looking for enthusiastic volunteers to help bring our 42nd Annual NAC Parade and PISVC Open House Art Show to life! Help our community showcase the many different presentations of this year's theme: "Voices That Shape Tomorrow" through community floats & performances at the parade and artistic displays at our PISVC Art Show.

 

This free, fun, and family-friendly event brings the celebration of Native American culture to the Phoenix community this October, and we'd love to have your support on our big day!

 

Find a volunteer role that fits your strengths!

 

Your time, energy, and support help create a welcoming, organized, and memorable experience for our participants, families, community members, and guests. We’re incredibly grateful for every volunteer who chooses to show up and be part of this day.

 

	
Parade Float Walker | 8:00–11:00 AM

	
Want to be part of the parade itself? Walk alongside the NAC float, represent NAC with pride, wave to spectators, and help bring energy and excitement to our parade presence.

	
Please be aware: This is an active outdoor role requiring walking the parade route.

 

	
Route Monitor | 8:00–11:00 AM

	
Help keep the parade route safe, organized, and enjoyable for everyone. Monitor your assigned area, provide basic directions, help spectators stay in designated viewing areas, and communicate questions or concerns to event leadership.

	
Please be aware: This is an outdoor role that may involve standing and walking for an extended period.

 

	
Registration & Hospitality | 7:00–9:00 AM

	
Be one of the friendly faces who helps get parade morning started right. Welcome participants and volunteers, assist with check-in, answer questions, provide directions, and help everyone get where they need to be.

 

	
Judge Area & Hospitality | 8:00–11:00 AM

	
Welcome judges and special guests, organize materials, provide supplies, and help connect judges with NAC event staff. Help make sure our parade judging experience runs smoothly.

 

	
Flex Volunteer | 7:00–9:00 AM

	
Our flexible support team jumps in wherever an extra hand is needed. Help with registration, setup, supplies, directions, or last-minute needs throughout the morning.

 

	
Art Show Support | Morning: 10:00 AM–12:00 PM & Afternoon: 12:00–2:00 PM

	
Keep the celebration going after the parade! Help welcome guests to the PISVC Art Show Open House, provide directions, assist with check-in and activities, and help create a welcoming space for community members.

 

Why Volunteer?

 

When you volunteer with Native American Connections at our Annual Parade & Open House, you’re helping create a day where community, culture, connection, and celebration come together.

 

As a volunteer, you’ll have the opportunity to:

	
Make a meaningful contribution to a community-centered event

	
Meet new people and connect with fellow volunteers, community members, and partners

	
Be part of this iconic celebration of Indigenous culture and experience the parade from a unique perspective

	
Support Native American Connections and help create a welcoming experience for everyone attending

 

Your Support Makes a Difference

 

A successful parade takes a community of people working together. Thank you for considering sharing your time, talents, and energy with Native American Connections. No matter which role you choose, your presence matters. We’re grateful to have you alongside us as we celebrate Voices That Shape Tomorrow.

opportunities.description:
At Fix-it Clinics, we support sustainable consumption and divert waste from landfills by repairing items that would otherwise end up in the trash. Our incredible team of volunteers can help you fix almost anything, including electronics, jewelry, clothing, bicycles, and more! 

Lead Volunteers will:
• Use hand tools and small power tools to repair everyday household items such as electronics, bicycles, kitchen appliances, jewelry, clothing, furniture, lamps, and more.
• Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Ensure workstations are maintained in a clean and organized manner to reduce exposure to chemicals, open electric circuits, and sharp objects or projections.

Other Volunteers will:
• Assist with the community member check-in process.
• Complete necessary “Fix-It” paperwork, which identifies if an item was fixed or was unrepairable.
• Assist with diagnosing items. 

Fix-It Clinics reduce the amount of waste going to the landfill, encourage responsible consumption, teach community members real-world skills, and build connections between Flagstaff residents.

If you are looking to bring in items to be repaired, please find more information along with the appointment signup link on the official Fix-It Clinic webpage: https://www.flagstaff.az.gov/3231/Fix-it-Clinic

opportunities.description:
Drop-Off Day connects residents with safe, free, and convenient disposal and recycling services for household hazardous waste and other hard-to-recycle materials. Through community partnerships, the events divert waste from the landfill, protect public health and the environment, and makes responsible disposal more accessible. We need help from volunteers to help keep the event running smoothly. 

Volunteer position and roles include:
(1) Greeters:
- Count the number of vehicles (using a clicker),  
- Provide directions to community members based on the items they brought. (Example: the e-waste vendor is at the fourth station around the bend.)   
- Provide community members with waste diversion outreach materials.  
- Help answer any questions if time allows. 

(2) Material Collection
- Assist with lifting items out of vehicles and placing them in the correct bin/area, as directed by station lead.

(3) Traffic Control
- Keep traffic moving safely.
- Direct vehicles to drop-off location.

(4) Rover/Floater
- Collect small drop-off items from vehicles to reduce traffic.
- Relieve other volunteers for breaks.
